title: Dependency ownership bounties and cutover dashboard
creator: Asha Rao
description:
Problem: Cutovers and milestone handoffs repeatedly slip because ownership of prerequisite items (runtime changes, design signoff, security checklist, infra capacity) is ambiguous across Eng/Design/Security/Infra. Current Linear tickets are fragmented and teams lack a single truth for readiness.

Proposal: Build a lightweight Cutover Dashboard that aggregates readiness signals from Linear issues, GitHub PR status, Figma approvals, security checklist items, and infra capacity reservations. Pair the dashboard with a temporary 'dependency bounty' program: explicit ownership incentives and short SLAs for clearing blockers before cutover windows. The bounty is non-monetary (badge, priority support, reduced PR review queues) and intended to quickly drive accountability while we iterate toward long-term ownership SLAs.

Scope: frontend dashboard (Console), backend signal ingestion (event pipeline), ownership UI in Linear (owner field + bounty tag), escalation rules (auto-notify PM/SRE after SLA), and playbook docs for cutover leads. Not in scope: hiring or permanent compensation changes, full org-wide SLA enforcement (this is an initial experiment).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows a cutover readiness timeline for at least 3 pilot initiatives including runtime, design, security, infra rows
Readiness signal sources wired: Linear issue owner/status, GitHub PR status (merged/pending/failing), Figma file signoff, security checklist status
Ownership bounty tag can be applied to Linear tickets and visible in dashboard; at least 6 tickets across two teams use it during pilot
Escalation rules trigger: if any critical readiness item is not green 48 hours before cutover, auto-notification sent to the initiative PM + SRE oncall
Dashboard latency for aggregated signals < 2 minutes for updates from CI/Linear webhooks
Pilot cutovers run with < 10% unplanned rollbacks attributable to dependency readiness failures (baseline measured and compared)
Documentation and playbook published in Confluence with checklist and runbook; 2 DRIs signoff (PM + Eng)
Post-pilot retrospective with recommended next steps scheduled within 1 week after pilot completion
tasks: PM: finalize pilot initiative list and cutover dates (Asha)
Eng: spike event ingestion from Linear + GitHub + CI to proof-of-concept signal aggregator (estimate 3 days)
Eng: implement minimal backend that computes per-ticket readiness state and exposes API for Console (Liam)
Design: UI mockups for cutover timeline and per-initiative heatmap; include mobile and narrow-screen variants (Mae)
Security: define automation-friendly checklist items and API-friendly status endpoints (Ravi)
Infra: expose capacity reservations and expected slot windows as a signal (Sasha)
Devops: configure webhook routing and retry/failure handling for upstream signal sources
PM: write bounty criteria and publish to the team handbook
Docs: Confluence PRD + playbook + cutover checklist
QA: run an end-to-end rehearsal for pilot initiative 1 and capture issues
decisions: Use non-monetary bounties for initial experiment to avoid HR complexity
Rollup signals at ticket-level instead of per-subtask to keep ingestion simple
Escalation threshold set to 48 hours before cutover for pilot; can be tuned post-retro
tradeoffs: Quick wins vs. long-term governance: bounty program may mask root cause of unclear ownership; plan to use pilot data to design permanent owner roles
Signal fidelity vs. engineering effort: initial implementation favors breadth of sources over deep normalization (we accept occasional false positives)
Automation vs. manual checks: some security approvals will remain manual during pilot; automation added iteratively
